description: This file defines common reusable Flutter widget components: CardShell, _LoadingBar, and EmptyState, used for UI presentation within a Flutter application.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A reusable surfaced card container with an Ocean theme feel, supporting icons, title, action buttons, and loading states.

classes.name: _LoadingBar
classes.description: A private widget representing a loading placeholder bar used within CardShell.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget that displays an empty state message with optional icon and compact layout.

methods.name: CardShell.loadingOrChild
methods.description: A static method that returns a CardShell with a shimmer-like loading placeholder or a provided child widget based on the isLoading parameter.

methods.name: CardShell.build
methods.description: Build method that constructs the CardShell widget with styling, optional icon, title, action, and child content.

methods.name: _LoadingBar.build
methods.description: Build method for the _LoadingBar widget, creating a styled bar representing loading state.

methods.name: EmptyState.build
methods.description: Build method that constructs the EmptyState widget with optional icon, message, and layout style.
